To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the institutional environment is important to economic performance, but that the institutional environment can change, and that this change is influenced by the actions of individuals.
the structure of institutions is important in determining the performance of individuals and groups.
the structure of institutions, as perceived by individuals, affects the performance of the institution.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how individuals interact with the institutions in which they are embedded.
the way institutions affect the behavior of individuals and the way individuals affect the structure of institutions.
the behavior of institutions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
institutions are important because they are the structure that affects the performance of economic activity.
institutions are human relationships that affect the way individuals perceive the world and the decisions that they make.
institutions are the rules of the game.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
individuals have limited rationality and limited ability to learn.
institutions are the rules of the game that are created by individuals and affect their behavior in the future.
individuals act in a situation, which is structured by institutions, which affects performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
institutions are not static. They are constantly changing as the situation changes, as the structure changes, or as performance changes.
individuals are not rational actors, but are boundedly rational, and that they are not forward looking, but are backward looking.
the institutional structure affects the behavior of individuals and, in turn, the structure of the institution.
